title: Adaptive Leadership Skills
overview: This course is designed to equip participants with the essential skills needed to help their organizations thrive in an ever-changing world. Through interactive sessions, participants will have the chance to enhance their adaptive leadership abilities, regardless of their role within the organization. The course offers practical tools and strategies for leading and mobilizing people, addressing complex challenges, and achieving exceptional results.
audience: This course is ideal for managers, business professionals, and anyone who wants to master the tools and techniques of adaptive leadership in a world where change is constant.
methodology: The course incorporates interactive exercises that allow participants to develop strategies for enhancing their adaptive leadership skills. It also includes analysis of case studies and real-world examples from the business world.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Differentiate between technical problems and adaptive challenges, and learn how to observe, interpret, and intervene effectively.
Understand the impact of the status quo on their organizations and diagnose systemic issues.
Foster an adaptive culture by engaging the entire system.
Develop a plan to identify their roles, prioritize tasks, and articulate goals in the face of adaptive challenges.
Apply strategies to recognize and manage the emotional aspects of leading adaptive change.
